listing.name: Pilotwings 64: Recompiled (Daniel Gomes Vieira)
listing.summary: Player-managed Pilotwings 64 setup on Windows and Linux using an original USA cartridge image.

steps.title: Prepare your original
steps.instruction: For an already permitted copy, keep the selected x64 package’s files together. Use your own 8 MiB Pilotwings 64 USA Rev 0 big-endian .z64 file in the upstream launcher. The direct input validator expects big-endian byte order.

steps.title: Start the matching upstream player
steps.instruction: On Windows open Pilotwings64Recomp.exe. On Linux use Pilotwings64Recomp.sh from the extracted folder with system SDL2, GTK 3, FreeType and a working Vulkan driver.

steps.title: Preserve the actual profile
steps.instruction: Keep the selected profile and creating runtime. The default profile is LOCALAPPDATA/Pilotwings64Recomp on Windows and XDG_DATA_HOME/Pilotwings64Recomp on Linux, usually ~/.local/share/Pilotwings64Recomp. A portable.txt beside the executable keeps the profile alongside it.

warnings: The selected package’s notices identify missing RecompFrontend permission and other component terms. Fresh managed acquisition needs a documented grant or a suitable replacement.
Keep the upstream folder outside the Portcove library. Close the game and its helpers before backing up or replacing the creating runtime and its data.
